# Kaio Barbosa (liftaris.dev)

> Full-stack software engineer and founder of Liftaris. Currently on the Commercial Websites team at Moderna.

Personal website and portfolio: https://www.liftaris.dev
GitHub: https://github.com/liftaris
Location: Seattle, WA (open to NYC)

## Background

Kaio Barbosa is a software engineer and founder with full-stack and distributed systems experience across enterprise platforms, healthcare AI startups, and federal agency dashboards.
- **Current:** Commercial Websites team at Moderna, building a module-federated web platform, commercial LLM translation workflows, and regulatory healthcare platforms.
- **Founder:** Liftaris (video game intelligence and streaming analytics).
- **Past:** Health Note (early clinical AI assistant startup), Parsons (data visualization dashboards for FAA and CBP), Freelance (WASM bindings for HNSWLib, Replit bounties, Unity).
- **Education:** UC Santa Cruz (B.S.).

## Liftaris (Company & Vision)

Kaio is the founder of Liftaris, an early-stage startup building specialized video game intelligence and stream analytics platforms.
- **Inception & Prototype:** Liftaris started with BazaarGhost (https://bazaarghost.stream), a stream analytics website and computer vision pipeline for players of *The Bazaar* that reached 18,000+ unique visitors in month one.
- **Mission:** Liftaris scales the prototype into a comprehensive video game intelligence platform with a deep connection to streaming audiences across Twitch, YouTube, and other live platforms.
- **Claude & AI Foundation:** Liftaris uses Claude and frontier LLM tooling to build the underlying analysis, data extraction, and platform foundation.
- **Status:** Liftaris is currently an early-stage startup; `liftaris.dev` serves as the founder's visible portfolio and technical sandbox until out of stealth.

## Featured Projects

- [BazaarGhost](https://bazaarghost.stream): Computer vision and OCR pipeline for Twitch VODs for The Bazaar, serving as the foundational prototype for Liftaris. Built with Python, OpenCV, PaddleOCR, FFmpeg, Supabase, and Next.js. GitHub: https://github.com/liftaris/bazaar-ghost.
- [Herm TUI](https://github.com/liftaris/herm): A terminal user interface (TUI) for Hermes Agent. Built with TypeScript, Bun, OpenTUI React, SQLite, and stdio JSON-RPC. Features streaming chat, markdown, diff chips, tool-call inspection, animated ASCII avatar, profile switching, and workspace tabs. Distributed on npm as `herm-tui`.

## Site Architecture

- **Framework:** Astro 5 with React components and Tailwind CSS.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure:** Cloudflare Workers, Static Assets, Smart Placement, and Cloudflare Images.
- **Data & Storage:** Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) via EmDash CMS, Cloudflare R2 (media/assets), Cloudflare KV (sessions and content caching).
- **Desktop UI:** Custom interactive 2D canvas simulation built with Matter.js and WinBox windowing.

## Writing & Articles

- [Bazaar Ghost](https://www.liftaris.dev/blog/bazaar-ghost): Engineering retrospective on launching the BazaarGhost computer vision pipeline, containerized video chunk processing, and scaling to 18,000 users.
- [Building a Website](https://www.liftaris.dev/blog/building-a-website): Philosophy on simplicity and maintainability in personal site architecture, balancing DIY custom engines with drag-and-drop builders.
- [Understanding L Systems](https://www.liftaris.dev/blog/understanding-l-systems): An exploration of Lindenmayer systems (L-systems), turtle graphics, and algorithmic plant modeling based on *The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants*.
